_comment: PLACEHOLDER consumable definitions for the ISOLATED item-drops lane. Loaded by DeNelle.Village.Items.ConsumableCatalog via DeNelle.Core.CanonicalJson. DARK by default (gated by ItemDropSystem.Enabled). A consumable's 'id' is also its VillageInventory larder key AND the output id of the matching crafting recipe in crafting-recipes.json - so crafting 'minor-heal-potion' deposits 'minor-heal-potion', and ConsumableUseService.TryUse('minor-heal-potion') consumes it + applies its effect. The OWNER + CREATIVE must finalise the real consumable roster, magnitudes, durations and art before this goes live. Example scaffolding only.

_schemaNotes.kind: potion | tent | food. Drives where it can be used and its UI bucket.
_schemaNotes.effect: heal | mana | buff | rest. v1 ConsumableUseService implements 'heal' (and 'rest' as a heal); mana/buff/duration are DEFERRED (no mana pool / buff system wired yet).
_schemaNotes.magnitude: heal amount (HP) for heal/rest; percent or flat for buffs (deferred).
_schemaNotes.usableInFight: true = potions/food usable mid-fight; false = rest-only (tent kits).
